heroIntro: I started Lift Pickleball because I love watching someone go from "I hope I don't embarrass myself out there" to "I can't wait for my next game." That shift is the whole point.
story: I grew up playing tennis in high school, but pickleball is what really hooked me. Before I coached pickleball full-time, I coached professionally in a completely different arena: poker. Years spent teaching players to read situations, weigh risk, and make sharper decisions under pressure translated surprisingly well to a pickleball court.

These days I play and coach pickleball daily out of Walnut Creek, carrying a 4.8+ DUPR rating. My approach comes down to three words: Position. Placement. Power. — in that order. Most players try to overpower the ball before they've locked in where they're standing and where they're aiming. We fix that first, and the wins follow.

With Lift Pickleball, I've pointed that same strategy-and-analytics approach at adult beginners and improvers specifically — players picking up the game as adults, or leveling up from casual weekend rallies into real strategy. I love coaching this stage because the improvement curve is so rewarding to watch, and because too many capable players get taught by coaches who assume everyone already knows the fundamentals.

philosophy.title: Patient, not pressured
philosophy.description: There's no such thing as a silly question. We move at a pace that builds real confidence, not anxiety.

philosophy.title: One or two things at a time
philosophy.description: Real improvement comes from focusing on a couple of specific, fixable habits per lesson — not a firehose of tips.

philosophy.title: Fun is the strategy
philosophy.description: Players who are having fun practice more, relax more, and improve faster. So we keep it light.

philosophy.title: Strategy that wins games
philosophy.description: Beyond technique, we work on doubles positioning and shot selection — the stuff that actually wins points.
